stem: Leaf edge necrosis appears in one irrigation zone while neighboring zones on the same fertilizer batch look healthy. What is the strongest first diagnostic priority?
choices: Compare irrigation delivery, root-zone EC/moisture and spatial pattern before blaming the fertilizer formulation
Assume a genetic disorder because the symptom is localized
rationale: Spatial clustering under a shared nutrient batch points to local delivery or root-zone factors that should be measured before changing the whole nutrition program.
